[You scold me, AI doesn't scold.] Speaker A: Ye bahut mehenga hoga. School ki fees, tuition ki fees, upar se app ka kharcha. [This must be very expensive. Install button par click karo aur farratedar English bolo. [It's just a 3-day trial for 1 rupee. You also check out the app, then you too will speak fluent English like me. Click on the install button and speak fluent English.] Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
